tokens.name: state-listening
tokens.usage: Voice orb while the mic hears you. Shape: soft circle. Paired with the word "Listening" and earcon E1.

tokens.name: state-speaking
tokens.usage: Voice orb while the tutor talks. Shape: 9-point scallop. Paired with "Parlo is speaking" and E2.

tokens.name: state-thinking
tokens.usage: Voice orb between your turn and the reply. Shape: slow-rotating 4-leaf. Paired with "Thinking".

tokens.name: state-muted
tokens.usage: Voice orb when muted. Shape: circle outline with a slash glyph. Paired with "Muted".

tokens.name: state-reconnecting
tokens.usage: Voice orb during resume/reconnect. Shape: dashed ring. Paired with "Reconnecting…" and E5.
